scope: License scope for every file in this source and configuration snapshot. Retained notices and source-specific terms take precedence over project defaults.
data_scope: Fixed general source data, documented integrity repairs and separately licensed optional vocabulary modules.

luna.origin: Official Weasel 0.17.4 Luna dictionary with documented source-code integrity repairs.

essay.origin: Unchanged general essay frequency data from official Weasel 0.17.4.

symspell_core.origin: SymSpell v6.7.3 fixed frequency source and its declared Google Books Ngram/SCOWL components.
retained_terms: SymSpell MIT notice, copyright 2018 Wolf Garbe
Google Books Ngram CC BY 3.0 Unported notice
SCOWL composite copyright, sources and credits, including UKACD

ice.origin: Fixed Ice extension source and attributed program adaptations.

scowl_case.origin: SCOWL 2020.12.07 exact case evidence and original composite notices.
retained_terms: SCOWL composite copyright and source terms in full Copyright file
CHISE ids GPL version 2 or later
radical.caveat: Mirtle credits these sources, but the exact consumed data revisions and row-level lineage are unknown. Individually pinned supplementary notice snapshots are not represented as the exact Mirtle data inputs.

retained_terms: AUTHORS credits and CNS11643 redistribution statement

retained_terms: Unicode License V3, copyright Unicode, Inc.

bunka.origin: Agency for Cultural Affairs, joyo kanji index
retained_terms: Source attribution for published character, form and reading facts.

opencc.caveat: The JP master snapshot has a recorded content hash but no exact upstream commit established. Standard conversions shipped with the official profile are indexed separately as opencc_weasel.

project.origin: Original project code, configuration, generators, tests and explanatory prose.
project.retained_terms: GPL-3.0-only for original program material; CC BY-SA 4.0 for original explanatory prose.

mdx_reference.origin: Local curated MDX used as research reference only

original source comments and reference link

prelude.origin: rime/rime-prelude, official Weasel 0.17.4 packaged default, key bindings, punctuation and symbols
prelude.caveat: The notice snapshot is pinned separately. The precise historical prelude commit packaged by Weasel is unknown; the resource bytes are pinned by content hash.

opencc_weasel.origin: BYVoid/OpenCC conversion resources, official Weasel 0.17.4 data/opencc
opencc_weasel.caveat: The precise OpenCC data commit used for these packaged binaries is unknown; profile-manifest.json pins their bytes.

dlc_cedict.origin: CC-CEDICT public snapshot provided by MDBG; exact inputs and complete extraction rules in the module source records.

dlc_poetry.origin: Complete pinned Tang poems, Song poems, Song ci and companion anthologies from chinese-poetry.
retained_terms: MIT source terms; generated catalogs and annotations use CC-BY-SA-4.0.

dlc_pypinyin.origin: Pinned pypinyin 0.55.0 build-time reading software and data.

dlc_opencc.origin: OpenCC dictionaries at 556ed22496d650bd0b13b6c163be9814637970ae, used during catalog generation.

dlc_unihan.origin: Unicode Unihan 17.0.0, original-character reading fallback during catalog generation.

dlc_science.origin: Broad public Wikipedia subject assessments and Wikidata labels and aliases. Fixed original API response snapshots; article bodies excluded.

validation_marisa.origin: marisa-trie 1.3.1 native table decoder, validation only; not bundled with the input method.
